CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  CITY ARTS & CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION AGENDA
  Regular Meeting
  Wednesday, April 20, 2022 7:00 P.M.
  Alhambra City Hall
  111 South First Street, Alhambra, 91801
  Conference Room “A”

  I.  ROLL CALL
  Brian Canseco-Chan, President
  Patti Sanchez, Vice President
  Ari Arambula, Commission Member
  Gail Hermano, Commission Member
  Maria Jimenez, Commission Member

  II.  FLAG SALUTE

 III.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES OF THE MARCH 16, 2022 REGULAR MEETING

 IV.  ALHAMBRA ART ALLEY

  V.  STAFF REPORT
  2023 Rose Parade Float Renderings

 VI.  PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the public of any item not specified on the agenda. Comments must pertain to
  the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission. Public comments
  pertaining to the Commission’s business are welcome. Kindly limit all oral communications to
  five (5) minutes. Please complete the blue speaker card prior to the meeting and submit it to the
  Commission Secretary.

VII.  COMMISSION COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the Commission Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events
  Commission.

VIII.  ADJOURNMENT
  Discussion from the Commission Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events
  Commission.

 Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each type of business described herein above are on file in
 the office of Parks & Recreation, Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. First Street, Alhambra, and are available for public inspection
 during office hours: 7:00 A.M. to 12:00 P.M. Monday through Thursday. Should any person have a question concerning any
 of the above agenda items prior to the meeting described herein, please contact the Commission Secretary either in person or
 in the Parks & Recreation department located at City Hall or call (626) 570-5044 during regular business hours.
 Unofficial until adopted by the  April 20, 2022
City Arts and Cultural Events Commission  Action Item III
  APPROVE

  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION
  Wednesday, March 16, 2022
  7:00 P.M.

The regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission was called to order at
7:02 P.M. on Wednesday, March 16, 2022, at Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First Street
Alhambra, via Video Conference Zoom.

ROLL CALL
Committee Members Present: President Canseco-Chan, Vice President Sanchez, Commission
Member Arambula, and Commission Member Hermano.
Committee Members Absent: Commission Member Jimenez.
Also attending: Deputy Director Brie Houghton, Recreation Supervisor Amanda Leonard, and
Clerical Assistant II Kelsey Rivadeneyra.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES FROM THE FEBRUARY 16, 2022 C.A.C.E. MEETING
With a motion from Vice President Sanchez and a second by Commission Member Hermano, the
February 16, 2022 City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting minutes were approved.

ALHAMBRA ART ALLEY PROJECT
No update from the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission.

STAFF REPORT
Deputy Director Houghton shared event flyers, timelines, and layouts for the upcoming Bunny
Hop, Mission to Mission, and Eco Fair with the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission.
Commission Member Arambula inquired about vendor opportunities and suggested including an
“Egg Roll Contest” as another activity at the Bunny Hop event. Deputy Director Houghton and
Recreation Supervisor Leonard agreed to take it under consideration and look for a way to
incorporate it into this year’s event or the next year.

PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
None.

COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
Commission Member Arambula proposed a permanent display of historic Alhambra photos
inside Alhambra City Hall and Deputy Director Houghton said she would inquire with City
Clerk about a photo archive and could possibly put together a month-long art exhibition.
Commission Member Arambula also proposed having a light display that could reflect different
colors for remembrance and honor of special days and months.Deputy Director asked if
 Commission Member Arambula could provide her with more information so that she could get
quotes for Alhambra City Hall.

ADJOURNMENT
With a motion by Commission Member Arambula and seconded by Commission Member
Hermano, the March 16, 2022 City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting was adjourned
at 7:32 P.M.
